# Baseline reader fixture

These are the two ordinary items, canonical inventory, report artifact and final
release generated by `tools/verify-baseline-consumer.mjs` through the public
Catalog, Scan and Core APIs. The artifact has an ephemeral test signature; it is
not a production assessment. Only the inventory and alpha recipe were captured.
One synthetic provider succeeded and another failed. Both material files and
beta's recipe lack capture, despite their descriptors appearing in the inventory.

The fixture supports deterministic installed-reader integrity checks without
running a scanner or requiring Scan/Core dependencies in Catalog's unit suite.
The separate packed proof exercises real public authentication, partial/all-failed
acceptance, reuse and refusals with freshly generated fixture keys. Its retained
public trust file permits independent verification of that run's exact artifacts.
